purpose: Search independent georeferenced deep-submergence imagery for all 20 frozen Stage1 candidates without using imagery to move, resize, drop, or promote candidates.
allowed_visual_sources: NOAA National Database for Deep-Sea Corals and Sponges
HURL Pisces IV/V and RCV-150 records
NOAA Okeanos Explorer / Deep Discoverer records
Ocean Exploration Trust Nautilus / Hercules / Argus records
independence_rule: Visual SurveyID must not be FK140307 or ZHNG09RR and must represent an imaging vehicle/visual observation archive independent of the Stage1 discovery and Stage2 heldout bathymetric lineages.

frozen_distance_classes.DIRECT_IMAGE_SUPPORT: image observation horizontal distance <= candidate frozen radius_m
frozen_distance_classes.NO_IMAGE_COVERAGE: nearest qualifying image > 25000 m or no qualifying image

report_per_candidate: all qualifying image records within 25 km
